scientific_limitations: Fixed positive friction, velocity diffusivity and Poisson reset rate; no parameter-uniform extension.
Only the two Gaussian reset schemes, single particle, instantaneous resets and stationary observation-time sampling are covered.
Existing marginal exponential tails and stationary joint-renewal formulas are acknowledged prior results.
Originality comparison does not establish publication priority against all possible general conditional-limit theorems.
title: Universal velocity selection and protocol-dependent reset-age delay at extreme displacement
